hooks.command: CMD=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command'); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE 'git[[:space:]]+push[[:space:]]+[^[:space:]]+[[:space:]]+(main|master)([[:space:]:]|$)'; then echo 'BLOCKED: main is updated by merging pull requests, never by a push.' >&2; exit 2; fi

CMD=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command'); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE 'git[[:space:]]+add[[:space:]]+(--all([[:space:]]|$)|-A([[:space:]]|$)|\.([[:space:]]|$)|\*([[:space:]]|$))'; then echo 'BLOCKED: stage files by name; a bare git add -A or git add . can pick up secrets and scratch files.' >&2; exit 2; fi; if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE 'git[[:space:]]+add[[:space:]].*\.env([[:space:]]|\.|$)'; then echo 'BLOCKED: .env files are never committed.' >&2; exit 2; fi
